title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Hayward-campus places for studying, connecting, playing, and using campus resources.

cards.title: CORE Library
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Start here when you need books, loanable technology, study rooms, or a change of pace between classes; bring your Bay Card for library equipment.
cards.short_summary: The campus library combines collections, technology lending, study areas, and student-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB says the CORE building offers books, technology rentals, study rooms, presentation-practice rooms, a meditation room, and a family playroom.
cards.source_title: The CORE Building Shows How East Bay LEED’s the Way in Campus Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and room-reservation rules before visiting.

cards.title: The CORE’s quiet second floor
cards.subtitle: CORE Library, Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the quiet floor for solo reading or concentrated laptop work; the university describes seating with personal outlets and storage for your things.
cards.short_summary: A designated quieter library floor with individual-style seating and power access.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB identifies the CORE’s second floor as a quiet floor with seating, personal outlets, and storage space.
cards.source_title: The CORE Building Shows How East Bay LEED’s the Way in Campus Sustainability
cards.access_notes: Respect the quiet-floor setting and any posted library policies.

cards.title: Student Center for Academic Achievement
cards.subtitle: CORE Building, Room 343
cards.notes: Bring a course question, draft, or assignment prompt to connect with tutoring, writing support, supplemental instruction, or academic coaching.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support center for course help, writing, study strategies, and student success resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The SCAA lists tutoring, writing assistance, supplemental instruction, and academic coaching, and is located in CORE Building Room 343.
cards.access_notes: Located on the CORE Building’s third floor; consult SCAA for service availability.

cards.title: University Union
cards.subtitle: 25800 Carlos Bee Blvd., Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the Union as a practical meeting point before a program or between classes, then check its posted rooms, services, and current operations.
cards.short_summary: A campus gathering place for meals, programs, services, meetings, and informal interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB describes the University Union as a gathering place where campus community members meet for meals, programs, services, and informal interaction.
cards.access_notes: Services and room availability vary; consult the Union’s current hours and location information.

cards.title: GameZone
cards.subtitle: University Union, Hayward campus
cards.notes: Plan a low-key game break or look for a tournament or special event; ask staff about current game-room equipment and participation rules.
cards.short_summary: A University Union game area with staff-supported equipment and events.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s GameZone position description identifies a Game Room and Game Cave, equipment checkout, tournaments, and special events.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current GameZone hours, equipment availability, and facility policies before going.

cards.entity_name: C. E. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.title: C. E. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.subtitle: Meiklejohn Hall, Room 4047
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition calendar, then build in a short gallery stop before or after class; the museum also lists virtual-programming options.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus anthropology museum with rotating exhibitions and public gallery access.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum states that its galleries are in Meiklejohn Hall Room 4047 and that admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibits — C. E. Smith Museum of Anthropology
cards.access_notes: The museum page lists exhibition dates and gallery closures; verify the current schedule before visiting.

cards.title: WellNest Food Pantry
cards.subtitle: North University Union, first floor
cards.notes: If you need groceries, make an appointment through Bay Advisor, check in at the WellNest front desk, and bring your student ID to shop.
cards.short_summary: A campus food pantry with an appointment-based shopping process for students.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB directs Hayward students to check in at WellNest in the North University Union first floor and shop after an appointment and student-ID check-in.
cards.access_notes: Hayward service is appointment-based; follow the current Bay Advisor scheduling instructions.

cards.title: Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the recreation facility for an active study break or wellness routine, and review current facility access details before arriving with a guest.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation and wellness facility is a map-listed Hayward destination.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s current campus stop map identifies the Recreation and Wellness Center (RAW) on the Hayward campus.
cards.source_title: AC Transit Campus Stops Map — August 2025
cards.access_notes: Review Recreation and Wellness Center access requirements and current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Diversity and Inclusion Student Center
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the center, then check its current programming or services before planning a visit with classmates or student groups.
cards.short_summary: A named student center on the Hayward campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s campus stop map identifies the Diversity and Inclusion Student Center as a Hayward-campus destination.
cards.source_title: AC Transit Campus Stops Map — August 2025
cards.access_notes: Check the center’s current programming and access details before visiting.

cards.title: University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Hayward campus
cards.notes: Look up the gallery’s current exhibition and opening information, then pair a visit with time in nearby academic buildings or the campus transit stop.
cards.short_summary: A named University Art Gallery destination on the Hayward campus.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUEB’s current campus stop map identifies the University Art Gallery on the Hayward campus.
cards.source_title: AC Transit Campus Stops Map — August 2025
cards.access_notes: Verify current gallery exhibitions and public hours before visiting.
